Class TextWrapper

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.text.TextWrapper
public final class TextWrapper extends Object
Shared text layout and wrapping utility.

Handles line breaking, word wrapping, character wrapping, truncation (clip, ellipsis), and continuation indent strategies (hanging indent vs flush left). Correctly respects unicode display width, CJK wide characters, and grapheme clusters (ZWJ sequences, emoji flags).
